cases.prompt: A focused change leaves one dead import and exposes a stale nearby comment.

forbidden.pattern: refactor the whole|rewrite the module|clean the entire

cases.referenceAnswer: Remove the dead import and fix the stale comment as task-related housekeeping; keep the cleanup scoped.
cases.failureAnswer: Clean the entire package and refactor the whole module while here.

cases.prompt: A package change alters a generated manifest and requires a lockfile update.

forbidden.pattern: bump every version|update every snapshot|all metadata

cases.referenceAnswer: Follow the repository contract: regenerate the manifest from its source and update the required lockfile, without unrelated metadata churn.
cases.failureAnswer: Bump every version, update every snapshot, and rewrite all metadata.

cases.prompt: Plan a new input flowing through validation into a persistent side effect.
cases.referenceAnswer: Trace input source through validation and transformation, define the boundary interface and invariants, then identify the persistent sink and observable effect.
cases.failureAnswer: Add the field to the nearest function and save it.

cases.prompt: Investigate three independent package failures and then integrate the fixes through one shared interface.

forbidden.pattern: worker for every file|parallelize everything|skip individual verification

cases.referenceAnswer: Decompose the failures into bounded parts, map dependency and ordering edges, run the independent investigations concurrently, verify each part, then compose through the shared interface and test end-to-end.
